This is the PRODUCER of the pilot planner's throttle one-shot. 009C1877 takes the approach from ESI+4h and 009C187A the command block from approach+18h; 009C186A calls 007C47F0 and 009C1895 009BECD0 to compute a desired speed; then 009C189A FSTP [EDI+2B4h] stores it, 009C18A0 clears the byte cmd+2B0h, and 009C18A7 MOV dword [EDI+2D8h],1 raises the one-shot - with NO condition, on every call. 009C18C0's step 2 calls it through vtable+1Ch with the planar distance to the target, so the pair (+2B4h, +2D8h) is one command: here is the speed I want, act on it once. 0099D300 then reads plan+2D8h at 0099D7A5, and 0099D8C6 COMISS 0.001f against plan+2B4h decides between cutting the engine (a stop) and the demand arm; 0099D8CD's taken side jumps to 0099D924, PAST the flight-state test at 0099D8FD, so the demand runs in any flight state.
